analysis.reasonEn: RSI is moving from oversold (40.5) into neutral territory (50.7). MACD histogram is also improving, turning from negative to positive. The 5-day low ($56.33) is higher than the 20-day low ($55.69), suggesting a potential Higher Low pattern. However, ADX at 27.1 indicates a clear trend, but -DI (26.7) is higher than +DI (18.2), showing a prevailing downward pressure. Weekly RSI is at 57.6, entering a bullish zone. Due to a lack of clear directional alignment between daily and weekly indicators, a wait-and-see approach is maintained.
